dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 06, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Royals Rout Phillies in Blowout Win**

The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a 15-1 thrashing, with a strong team effort on both sides of the ball. Noah Cameron led the Royals' pitching staff, striking out seven in five innings while allowing just one earned run. On the other side, Trea Turner and Bryson Stott had standout performances for the Phillies, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Royals' potent offense. Tyler Tolbert was the top hitter for the Royals, going 5-for-5 with a home run and two RBIs.

**Yankees Take Down Rays in One-Sided Affair**

The New York Yankees cruised to a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, behind a strong start from Cam Schlittler. Schlittler pitched eight scoreless innings, striking out eight without walking a batter. José Caballero was the top hitter for the Yankees, going 2-for-3 with two home runs and four RBIs. Ben Rice also homered for the Rays, but it wasn't enough to prevent the loss.

**Nationals Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**

In a back-and-forth game, the Washington Nationals came from behind to defeat the Houston Astros 12-11. CJ Abrams was the top hitter for the Nationals, going 3-for-5 with a home run and three RBIs. Brice Matthews also homered for the Nationals, and Yainer Diaz, Braden Shewmake, and Nasim Nuñez all had big games. Cam Smith and Christian Walker also homered for the Astros, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Nationals' late-inning surge.
